name: Itadaki Street: Watashi no Omise ni Yottette
summary: The first entry in the Itadaki Street (known as Fortune Street in NA). Roll the dice to advance, buy stores, wait for other players, win gold, receive a salary, and aim to become the richest player. Utilize mechanics such as the option to forcibly buy another player's properties by paying 5 times the fee. There are a variety of boards to explore and characters to meet in this competitive game!
